description: Run a single-statement SELECT against the canvas dataframes registered by bls_get_series or by an earlier register_as. Read-only: writes, DDL, DROP, COPY, PRAGMA, ATTACH, and external-file table functions are rejected. System catalogs (information_schema, pg_catalog, sqlite_master, duckdb_*) are denied at the bridge layer — use bls_dataframe_describe to list available dataframes. Supports JOINs, aggregates, window functions, and CTEs. Optional register_as persists the result as a new dataframe with a fresh TTL for chained analysis. Canvas SQL operations consume zero BLS API quota. Requires CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=duckdb.

preview.description: Inline row preview count. Defaults to row_limit. Set lower (e.g. 50) when chaining via register_as and only a sample is needed immediately.

register_as.description: When set, persist the query result as a new dataframe under this name. Fresh TTL — not inherited from parent tables. Use to chain analyses without re-running source SQL or consuming additional BLS quota.

row_limit.description: Hard cap on rows materialized in the response (default 1000, max 10000). Full results live on-canvas under register_as when provided.

sql.description: Single-statement SELECT against df_<id> tables on the shared canvas. Reference dataframes by the names returned in bls_get_series responses or listed by bls_dataframe_describe. Standard DuckDB SQL — joins, aggregates, window functions, CTEs all supported. Example: SELECT series_id, year, period, value FROM df_AAAAA_BBBBB WHERE year >= '2020' ORDER BY year DESC.

name: bls_dataframe_query

cap.description: The preview or row_limit cap that was applied.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_unavailable`: The DataCanvas service is not configured for this deployment. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 expiry for the newly registered dataframe, when applicable.

notice.description: Guidance when results were capped by preview or row_limit — names which parameter was the binding limiter and suggests how to retrieve the rest. Absent when all rows fit in the response.

registered_as.description: Set when register_as was supplied and the result was materialized.

row_count.description: Rows materialized by the query. Exact when register_as is used; otherwise equals row_limit when truncated is true.

rows.description: Materialized rows, bounded by preview / row_limit.

truncated.description: True when the returned rows were capped.

title: Query BLS Dataframes
